About IUK

A trusted name in international medical education

Established in 1993 by Decree of the President of the Kyrgyz Republic, the International University of Kyrgyzstan (IUK) is one of the country's leading higher education institutions, known for academic excellence and global education.

Located in the capital city of Bishkek, IUK's Institute of Medicine offers a modern learning environment tailored for international students. The 5-year General Medicine (M.D.) program, plus a 1-year internship, is taught 100% in English and is specifically designed to meet global healthcare standards. The medical infrastructure is spread across highly specialized hubs — the Eastern Medical Campus (the central academic hub for theoretical medical education), the Morphological Campus (basic medical sciences, a 3D anatomy museum and microbiology labs), and Amanat Hospital, IUK's own teaching hospital with a simulation training centre — giving students experienced faculty, advanced teaching methodologies, and classmates from diverse nationalities, and preparing graduates for successful global careers in medicine.

Approvals & Recognitions

Globally recognized, legally accredited

IUK maintains comprehensive legal and international recognitions, making its graduates eligible to practice globally.

WHO / WDOMS

Officially published and listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools under FAIMER School ID: F0006555. Listed as currently operational.

ECFMG (USA)

Listed among medical schools eligible for the ECFMG 2027 Certification Pathways. Graduates are eligible under Pathway 3 to take USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK and pursue residency in the United States.

WFME Recognition via IAAR

IUK's educational programs hold international accreditation from the Independent Agency for Accreditation and Rating (IAAR), an agency formally recognized by the World Federation for Medical Education (WFME).

State Accreditation (Kyrgyz Republic)

Holds a new State Accreditation Certificate issued in 2026, valid from 29 May 2026 to 29 May 2032, covering the General Medicine program.

National Programme Accreditation

The medical curriculum meets national higher education standards, certified by the Agency for Accreditation of Educational Programmes and Organisations (AAOPO).

NMC (India) Compliance

Fully complies with the National Medical Commission's FMGL Regulations 2021 — English medium instruction, 54-month minimum course duration, and a 12-month clinical internship.

Programs

Doctor of Medicine (M.D.)

Two pathways to a globally recognized medical degree — we'll help you choose the right one.

Eligibility Criteria

To secure admission into the General Medicine (M.D.) program at IUK, applicants must meet the following criteria:

Secondary School Graduation (12th Standard / equivalent)
Physics, Chemistry & Biology (PCB) in final years
NEET qualification (for Indian students)
English proficiency

University Life

VIP Hostel & campus community

A safe, comfortable home away from home — with sports grounds, student clubs, and a vibrant multicultural community.

VIP & Standard Hostels

Well-equipped, comfortable accommodation with secure environments — turnstile access lets students focus on their studies with peace of mind.

Indian Mess Hall

A dedicated, comfortable mess hall serving nutritious meals, including North and South Indian food, and a welcoming space to connect.

Library & Digital Support

Access to a comprehensive library and research centre with extensive medical literature, journals, and digital learning resources.

Sports & Recreation

Outdoor fitness spaces, a football ground, table tennis, and badminton facilities for an active campus life.

Clinical Exposure

Direct bedside clinical experience through Amanat Hospital, IUK's own multi-storey teaching hospital.

Student Life

Student Council, Volunteer Club, and cultural events that encourage leadership, community service, and creative expression.
